messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: GPU pool us-west-2/highmem-1 saturated (queue depth 14k), error rate 12%, 429 surge. Autoscale attempts failing. Paging on-call.

maya: seeing huge spike in queued requests and 429s from the rate limiter. Dashboard shows active pods at pool max (48) and pending scale-up stuck.

ryan: autoscaler logs show `failed to acquire lock for pool us-west-2/highmem-1` repeated. looks like a locking/deadlock in the scaler leader election after a control-plane failover.

samir: also noticed token-bucket telemetry — token refill for tier "standard" dropped to 0.2 qps unexpectedly after last config push. That may be amplifying 429s.

elaine: CS pinged: a few paying customers are seeing request failures and slow responses. Need immediate mitigation and a short customer note.

priya: oncall here, taking lead. quick mitigation plan: 1) open burst capacity (bump pool limit), 2) pause/enforce lenient tokenbucket for standard tier, 3) enable fallback to smaller model for low-priority traffic, 4) restart autoscaler leader to break lock. I'll coordinate.

derek: I can patch infra to open extra nodes and flip tokenbucket. Samir — what's the exact tokenbucket key and desired rate to set temporarily?

samir: key is `rate_limit:tier:standard`. Set refill to `50` tokens/sec and bucket size `5000` for now. Also set `enforce=false` so throttling doesn't drop to 429 immediately.

samir: snippet (redis ACL-backed config):
```
# temp override
rate_limit:tier:standard:
  refill_per_sec: 50
  bucket_size: 5000
  enforce: false
```

derek: applying override via infra-api now:
```
curl -X POST https://infra-api.internal/config/ratelimit \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"key":"rate_limit:tier:standard","refill":50,"size":5000,"enforce":false}'
```

deploy-bot: config-change:ratelimit 2298765433 by derek — status: queued -> applied

derek: config applied. Confirmed token refill metrics now show +45/sec. 429 rate dropping in the last 30s.

priya: I'm kicking a controlled pool expansion to add 12 GPUs to hotpath (bump to 60). Command:
```
kctl pool scale us-west-2/highmem-1 --add 12 --reason "incident mitigation"
```

deploy-bot: pool-scale 2298765440 initiated by priya — expected ready in ~3m

maya: also enabling fallback to gpt-small for 'standard' route to reduce per-request GPU time. routing rule updated.

ryan: autoscaler restart plan: rotate leader on control-plane to clear lock. Samir — can you confirm no leader persists after restart?

samir: yes, I'll drain the leader process and force a re-election. doing `systemctl restart autoscaler` on leader node.

samir: logs during restart:
```
[INFO] stopping autoscaler - initiating leader handoff
[WARN] failed to release lock: already expired
[INFO] new leader elected: autoscaler-3
[INFO] autoscaler started; evaluating pending scale requests
```

samir: after restart, queued scale-up requests were picked up and nodes provisioning started.

priya: pool scale completed. New pods are joining, queue depth dropping from 14k -> 2.6k.

elaine: CS drafted a short note: "We experienced degraded performance and request throttling in us-west-2 earlier today. We've applied mitigations and are restoring normal service. We'll follow up with a root cause and timeline." Will share to affected customers in 30m. :heart:

derek: I also toggled tokenbucket enforcement back to `true` but kept refill high for a gradual ramp; plan to revert to normal rates after traffic stabilizes. command used:
```
curl -X POST https://infra-api.internal/config/ratelimit \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"key":"rate_limit:tier:standard","refill":20,"size":2000,"enforce":true}'
```

deploy-bot: config-change:ratelimit 2298765455 by derek — status: applied

maya: metrics check: 429s dropped from 12% -> 0.6% over 5m, p95 latency back within SLO for priority customers. Low-priority still seeing some throttling but routing fallback serving most.

priya: next steps: 1) run postmortem on autoscaler leader election bug, 2) investigate why tokenbucket config regressed at 08:12 UTC (recent config push?), 3) add alert to warn on token refill < 1 qps for > 2m, 4) schedule longer-term fix to decouple tokenbucket enforcement from single config path.

ryan: opening incident ticket and assigning ops/infra to RCA. tagging k8s and rate-limiter teams.

elaine: sending CS note now and opening Jira for impacted customers. Will provide ETA for full RCA in 48h.

cs-bot: customer-impact-log: customers A123, B987 reported errors. Escalation created: INC-229876. Assigned: elaine.

maya: thanks team. oncall -> handing to Derek for overnight watch. I'll join the RCA tomorrow.

derek: taking handoff. monitoring dashboards and will escalate if 429s >1% or queue >3k. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied, partial service restored. Will remain open for RCA.
